description: Portrait of O'Keeffe walking towards the camera  looking down at the ground as if in deep in thought, surrounded by an arid desiccated landscape with buttes and clouds in the background. Her hair is pulled back in a bun, she wears a black wrap dress cinched at the waist with her Hector Aguilar belt, oversized leather work gloves, and brown shoes.
title: Hard thinking O'Keeffe biting her lips
